0.5.5.2024 Update : First animal update

- added lion 
- added crocodile 
- added vulture 
- sound fixes on hippo

- created custom spawn zones, so not all animals spawn in all areas of the map.  Crocs will only spawn on the coast. The lion will only spawn in the center of the map, as well as the wildebeest, the vulture will spawn in all areas, the rhino will only spawn near the lakes. 

- increased the amount of animals being spawned. 
- increased the damage, and run speed on animals. 


In the next animal updates I will be working on herding behavior, grazing behavior, multiple attack animations, multiple sounds effects, hit sounds effects and generally improving the behavior of the AI.

notes.title: Status update
notes.notes:
Just a quick update for the people who do still support the project : 

It's not dead, like I have stated before. In the last year, unfortunately, I have had to stop focusing on development and work a normal fulltime job, as profits from age of survival could not support me or any other developer working full time to continue the project. 

I am continuing development on the project in my free time, including a complete, from the ground up, build of the project for VR only. There have also been times where I have had to wait for certain technologies in unity3d to become available, as they just did not exist beforehand, like navmesh generation for very large terrains, or dynamic navmesh generation for infinite terrains.  

I would like to bring you the main promised features, please do be aware on a one man team, with very limited funds,and even more limited time it will take a great deal of time for me to bring you updates. I have not forgotten the project, and frankly it was my baby for years before release and could never do that. 



I do have to touch on wanting to develop also when I recieve threats, negative comments, etc through email, steam, my personal facebook page, and my personal youtube account. It doesn't make me a happy person, and if you put yourself in my shoes, after reading and deleting such negative comments off of my personal social media avenues it might make a person not want to communicate with the community on steam at the very least.  I'm not telling anyone to stop saying what they are saying, but if you put yourself in my shoes you have to understand how low my motivation to help said people can be at times. 

That is all, please consider that developers are human beings as well. 


I have no timeline for updates unfortunately, but they will come.

You can find the rhino hanging out in the valley, there are a maximum of 25 of them. They spawn out in a random radius every 10 - 60 seconds. The spawning is pooled, and they will respawn on death.

There is a lot of fine tuning to do on the new AI system, so expect the behavior to improve.

I'm also working on detailing the island more, working on another fresh water source you can drink at, and better loot for the trees (trees will have different loot like coconuts, fronds or leaves, etc)

Lots of new things coming, will update builds more today as I get the new animals AI replaced.

notes.title: 0.0.0.1.2.9 Patch notes
notes.notes:
Hi there everyone, just uploaded a new build to steam a minute ago. 

0.0.0.1.2.9 Patch notes

- raised the fall damage threshold, this means you will not take damage from falling small distances.

- players no longer "burn" when in multiplayer mode.  This had to do with the fire on the player's torch not beind de-activated on instancing the player.

Also note if you find yourself spawning underwater and can't escape, LeftAlt + S will kill your player and respawn him at a spawn point again, which are all above ground.

I will be uploading another build late tonight, which will fix the issue of your player having to find wood to be able to craft your first weapon. 

You will instead start with a default weapon (the beating stick) and you can go straight to hitting and chopping things.


Thank you all for the support and first day purchases. Continue with us along the week as we will be fixing all the issues we can get fixed, asap.   This thursday is my birthday, and will be away from the computer, but will return back to it on friday and the weekend. 

Once again, thank you all very much, and you guys rock.

Hi there! I am uploading the press release  to steam right now, there are a few things to keep in mind. 

Firstly the number of animals spawned out right now is quite a bit smaller than what it will be in the next few days (yes we will be doing updates during the press release process). The animals spawned out right now are all land animals. Once we have animal spawning fully networked and optimized, I will begin placing out sea life. Please allow a few days for this to happen. 

There is currently only single player mode in the press release today, 8/14 11:21 a.m.   I am going to be uploading a version with Multiplayer in the EXPERIMENTAL branch on steam. To  activate the experimental version, go to your steam library and right click Age of Survival, then settings. There is then a Betas tab, where you will be able to pick the experimental branch. Download that branch and you will be able to activate a very early build of our multiplayer functionality. Please note this is still being worked on heavily.

Inventory bugs exist in this version, we are having it worked on.
